_comment: TEMPLATE -- copy the 'touchdesigner' block into your real claude_desktop_config.json (Windows: %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json ; macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json), then replace BOTH <ABSOLUTE_PATH_TO_CLONE> placeholders with the absolute path to YOUR clone of this repo. Use forward slashes even on Windows. Delete this _comment key. Tip: run 'python scripts/setup.py' to have these paths filled in automatically for your machine.

_notes.command: Absolute path to the built gateway binary. On Windows it ends in .exe; on macOS/Linux drop the extension. The binary is at <clone>/gateway/target/release/touchdesigner-bridge-mcp[.exe].
_notes.TDMCP_GW_HEADLESS: REQUIRED for an MCP client launch. The same binary is a GUI by default; this env var makes it serve MCP over stdio instead. Without it, Claude Desktop would open a window and the MCP handshake would never complete.
_notes.TDMCP_REPO: Absolute path to your clone. Points the gateway at the bundled reference data (reference/recipes.json, reference/catalog.json) so operator/recipe lookups resolve deterministically.
